nodes.description: ERC20 private mapping(address=>uint256) _balances holding token balances
ERC20 private nested mapping _allowances holding spender approvals
ERC20 private uint256 _totalSupply total minted supply
ERC20 private string _name token name
ERC20 private string _symbol token symbol
GeneratorCopyright private string _version generator version string
SimpleERC20 constructor that requires initialBalance_ > 0 and mints supply to _msgSender()
ERC20 transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) forwarding to _transfer
ERC20 transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) using allowance
ERC20 approve(address spender, uint256 amount) forwarding to _approve
ERC20 increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) adding to allowance
ERC20 decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) subtracting from allowance
ERC20 internal _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) updating balances
ERC20 internal _mint(address account, uint256 amount) increasing total supply and balance
ERC20 internal _burn(address account, uint256 amount) decreasing balance and total supply
ERC20 internal _approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount) writing allowance
ERC20 internal virtual hook _beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount)
ERC20 balanceOf(address account) reading _balances
ERC20 allowance(address owner, address spender) reading _allowances
ERC20 totalSupply() returning _totalSupply
Context internal _msgSender() returning msg.sender
ServicePayer payable constructor that performs external call IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName)
msg.sender used as caller identity inside Context._msgSender and constructor minting
External payable call IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) to a caller-supplied receiver, a reentrancy surface
Arithmetic balance mutation senderBalance - amount and _balances[recipient] += amount in _transfer
Arithmetic supply mutation _totalSupply += amount and _balances[account] += amount in _mint
string memory name_ constructor parameter
string memory symbol_ constructor parameter

address recipient parameter of transfer

uint256 currentAllowance local in transferFrom/decreaseAllowance allowance checks
uint256 senderBalance local in _transfer balance read and check

edges.reason: _balances mapping is read inside _transfer to validate and compute sender balance
_transfer writes updated sender and recipient balances into _balances
_balances is read and increased in _mint for the recipient account
_mint performs _balances[account] += amount
_balances is read in _burn to verify account balance
_burn writes accountBalance - amount back into _balances
balanceOf returns _balances[account]
totalSupply returns the _totalSupply state variable
_mint reads _totalSupply before incrementing it
_mint performs _totalSupply += amount
_burn reads _totalSupply before decrementing it
_burn performs _totalSupply -= amount
_approve writes the new allowance into the _allowances mapping
_approve mutates _allowances[owner][spender]
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] to check allowance
allowance returns _allowances[owner][spender]
_msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender caller identity
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender of the tokens
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender for the allowance check
approve uses _msgSender() as owner of the allowance
increaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as owner of the allowance
decreaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as owner of the allowance
SimpleERC20 constructor mints the whole supply to _msgSender()
feeReceiver_ constructor parameter is cast to IPayable and used as external call target
ServicePayer constructor performs an external payable call to a caller-supplied receiver, enabling reentrant control flow
_transfer reaches the unchecked-style balance arithmetic on sender and recipient
_mint reaches the total supply and balance addition arithmetic
transfer calls _transfer
transferFrom calls _transfer to move the tokens
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the remaining allowance
approve calls _approve
increaseAllowance calls _approve with the increased value
decreaseAllowance calls _approve with the decreased value
SimpleERC20 constructor calls _mint for the initial supply
SimpleERC20 constructor inherits ServicePayer and triggers its payable constructor
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook
_mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook
_burn invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook
name_ parameter flows into the ERC20 constructor call
symbol_ parameter flows into the ERC20 constructor call
initialBalance_ parameter is validated and minted
feeReceiver_ parameter is forwarded to ServicePayer
recipient parameter flows into transfer
amount parameter flows into transfer
sender parameter flows into transferFrom
spender parameter flows into approve
amount parameter flows into approve
account parameter flows into balanceOf lookup
currentAllowance local is derived and checked in transferFrom
senderBalance local is derived and checked in _transfer

normalization_plan.reason: name_ is a constructor parameter of SimpleERC20 and merges into the constructor function
symbol_ is a constructor parameter of SimpleERC20 and merges into the constructor function
initialBalance_ is a constructor parameter consumed by the constructor mint call
feeReceiver_ parameter is consumed by the ServicePayer constructor external call
recipient is the transfer destination parameter and merges into transfer
amount is the transfer value parameter and merges into transfer
sender is the transferFrom source parameter and merges into transferFrom
spender is the approve target parameter and merges into approve
amount is the approve value parameter and merges into approve
account is the balanceOf lookup parameter and merges into balanceOf
currentAllowance local is created and validated inside transferFrom
senderBalance local is created and validated inside _transfer
